lines.text: Via delle Fornaci 7 · Borgo Valdorso (TO) · Production plant
The chlorinated rubber range (CR-55 swimming-pool and road-marking paints) is
discontinued: the chlorinated rubber resin is no longer available from our supplier and
the solvent-borne road-marking market has been lost.
Last production: September 2009. Remaining stock to be sold by March 2010.
